sessions: Register, inspect and end agent sessions.
sessions begin: Register this agent session with Yoke.
sessions checkpoint: Record a finished workflow step for this session.
sessions checkpoint-read: Read this session's last recorded step.
sessions create: Launch a new agent session for a project.
sessions end-if-empty: End this session if it holds no work.
sessions hook-overhead: Report time spent in harness hooks recently.
sessions identity: Show this session's identity as the server sees it.
sessions keepalive: Keep an idle session from being ended.
sessions keepalive hold: Keep a session alive while it holds no work.
sessions keepalive release: Let a held session end when idle again.
sessions list: List registered sessions and whether they are live.
sessions reclaim-stale: End idle sessions and release their claims.
sessions steering groups list: List the live steering seats you can see.
sessions steering-groups list: List the live steering seats you can see.
sessions terminate: End a session for good and release its claims.
sessions touch: Mark this session as alive and set its mode.
sessions watcher-activity: Record that a running watcher did work.
